title: Oh Boy, Was I Wrong About Her Anime Reveals New Visual, Trailer, July 6 Premiere
content: The previously announced Oh Boy, Was I Wrong About Her (Tenbin) anime revealed a new visual and trailer along with a July 6 premiere d The anime stars: • Ikumi Hasegawa as Haruki Nikado • Shunichi Toki as Hayato Kirishima • Miharu Hanai as Himeko Kirishima • Natsumi Haruse as Minamo Mitake • Fuka Izumi as Saki Murao…
author: Anime Corner

title: Ranma 1/2 Season 3 New Trailer Revealed Ahead of October Return
content: Ranma 1/2 Season 3 revealed a new teaser trailer, with the anime set to premiere on Netflix in October 2026. Studio MAPPA is back to handle the animation, with Konosuke Uda returning to direct alongside most of the core staff. Season 2 aired in the Fall 2025 season .
author: Anime Corner

title: Dorohedoro Season 3 Special Teaser Trailer Revealed
content: Dorohedoro Season 3 anime revealed a special teaser trailer during MAPPA’s 15th anniversary presentation event. The anime was previously announced right after the Season 2 finale.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Koiseyo Mayakashi Tenshi-domo' Unveils Main Staff, Teaser Promo
content: The 15th Anniversary Event of MAPPA unveiled the main staff, teaser visual (pictured) and promotional video for the television anime adaptation of Coco Uzuki 's Koiseyo Mayakashi Tenshi-domo ( Fall in Love, You False Angels ) manga on Friday. The anime is scheduled to premiere in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Attack on Titan 3 Game to Get Opening Animation by MAPPA
content: MAPPA revealed that it will be in charge of the animation production for the opening of Attack on Titan 3 game. The announcement was made during MAPPA’s 15th anniversary presentation.
author: Anime Corner

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4: The Culling Game Part 2 Anime Reveals Teaser Video
content: The " MAPPA 15th Anniversary Lineup Reveal" livestream event on Friday revealed a teaser video for Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4: The Culling Game Part 2 , the fourth season of the Jujutsu Kaisen anime. The video states the anime is in production but does not give a release window.
author: ANN

title: Young Ladies Don't Play Fighting Games Unveils Main Trailer, Additional Cast
content: Young Ladies Don’t Play Fighting Games anime unveiled a main trailer on Friday along with four additional cast members. The trailer also features the opening theme song “Inochi Mijikashi Tai Suru Otome yo!” by Hanabie and the ending theme song “New Game” by halca.
author: Anime Corner

title: Beat & Motion Anime Reveals New Details, MAPPA Confirmed as Animation Studio
content: New information has been revealed for the upcoming BEAT & MOTION anime adaptation, including the confirmation that MAPPA will animate the project. As previously confirmed, Netflix will stream the anime worldwide. The announcement was made during MAPPA’s 15th anniversary presentation.
author: Anime Corner

title: MAPPA Officially Tackles New Shojo Anime Adaptation With Fall in Love, You False Angels
content: MAPPA will officially animate the anime adaptation of Coco Uzuki’s award-winning shojo manga Fall in Love, You False Angels . The TV anime was previously announced on June 11 and it is set to release some time in 2027.
author: Anime Corner

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 Culling Game Part 2 First Trailer Revealed
content: JUJUTSU KAISEN Season 4 , Culling Game Arc Part 2, revealed the first anime teaser trailer featuring some of the upcoming fights. The announcement was made during MAPPA’s 15th anniversary presentation.
author: Anime Corner
